description: A clickable region projected onto a rendered report page during layout. It anchors an element's ReportDrillThroughAction to the element's rectangle and carries the bound data-point field values so a Field-source parameter mapping resolves against the real clicked context.

members.name: Action
members.description: Drill-through action navigated when the region is clicked.

members.name: Context
members.description: Field values of the clicked data point, used to evaluate field-sourced parameter mappings.

members.name: Label
members.description: Optional accessible label describing the drill-through target.

members.name: PageNumber
members.description: One-based page number the region belongs to.
